description: Senior reviewer finds inference bug and mentors implementer. Strong technical and communication performance.

prContext.title: Add schema inference engine
prContext.description: Infers Zod schemas from TypeScript interfaces at compile time.
prContext.instructions: Review for type system correctness and performance.

groundTruth.description: Type checker is a comment placeholder — actual implementation likely creates a new Program per call, which is extremely expensive. Must reuse the existing TypeScript program/checker.
No handling for arrays, unions, enums, tuples, or intersections — these all fall through to z.unknown(), producing incorrect schemas for common types.
Non-null assertion (!) on find result — if typeName does not exist in the file, this throws at runtime. Should validate and throw a descriptive error.
No memoization — recursive types will cause infinite recursion and stack overflow. Should cache visited types.

reviewer_comments.what: Creating a new TypeScript program per call is extremely expensive.
reviewer_comments.why: TypeScript type checking is the dominant cost. Reuse the existing checker from the transformer context.
reviewer_comments.suggestion: Pass the checker as a parameter or store it in module state.

reviewer_comments.what: Arrays, unions, enums, and tuples all fall through to z.unknown().
reviewer_comments.why: These are common types. The schema inference will silently produce wrong validators.
reviewer_comments.suggestion: Add cases for ts.TypeFlags.Array, type.isUnion(), and type.isEnumLiteral().

reviewer_comments.what: Non-null assertion on find() result will throw a confusing error if typeName is missing.
reviewer_comments.why: Better to throw a descriptive error like `Type ${typeName} not found in file`.

reviewer_comments.what: Recursive types will cause infinite recursion here.
reviewer_comments.why: interface Node { next: Node } will recurse forever. Add a visited Set keyed by type ID.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Performance and coverage are blocking. Error handling and recursion are recommended.

implementer_responses.updated_code: export function inferSchema(checker: ts.TypeChecker, sourceFile: ts.SourceFile, typeName: string) {

implementer_responses.content: Added array, union, and enum handling.
implementer_responses.updated_code: if (type.symbol?.name === "Array") return z.array(typeToZod((type as ts.TypeReference).typeArguments![0], checker)); if (type.isUnion()) return z.union(type.types.map(t => typeToZod(t, checker))); ...
const decl = sourceFile.statements.find(...); if (!decl) throw new Error(`Type ${typeName} not found in ${sourceFile.fileName}`);

const visited = new Set<number>(); function typeToZod(type: ts.Type, checker: ts.TypeChecker): z.ZodTypeAny { if (visited.has(type.id)) return z.lazy(() => typeToZod(type, checker)); visited.add(type.id); ... }

verdict.summary: All four fixes verified. Checker reuse, expanded types, error messages, and recursion guard are all correct.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified all four fixes. Recursion guard with lazy() is the correct pattern. Level 4-5.
